title: From Immersion to Incorporation
role_in_volume: TITULAR SYNTHESIS CHAPTER. Calleja introduces 'incorporation' as the volume's metaphorological replacement for 'immersion' + 'presence'; resolves all four conceptual challenges from IG-02; integrates the 6-dimensional PIM under a single bidirectional double-axis metaphor; supplies two interview-grounded vignettes (Rheric/Guild Wars; Kumacho/Planetside) as empirical demonstration; closes by repositioning virtual environments as 'domains continuous with the media-saturated reality of everyday life' (p.179).

outline.title: (Unnamed opening) — Recapitulation + Unidirectional-Plunge Diagnosis
outline.summary: Calleja restates Ch.2's four conceptual challenges (absorption-vs-transportation conflation; non-ergodic-media specificity; technological determinism; missing attentional continuum) and adds the fifth implicit critique that defines Ch.10: the 'unidirectional plunge into a virtual world' metaphor presupposes that the external world can be excluded by submergence, which is empirically and theoretically wrong. The player is not 'a subjective consciousness being poured into the containing vessel of the game.' He reframes awareness of the game world as 'an absorption into our mind of external stimuli that are organized according to existing experiential gestalts (Lakoff and Johnson, 2003; Damasio, 2000)' (p.167 lines 5878-5882). The Lakoff+Johnson verbatim block-quote (p.168 lines 5901-5907 — paraphrased below) supplies the experientialist-ontology grounding. Richards 1936 + Lakoff+Johnson 2003 jointly underwrite the constitutive-not-deviation reading of metaphor (p.168 lines 5911-5913). Lévy 1998 is cited (p.168 line 5921) against contrasting virtual and real worlds.

outline.title: (Unnamed core-definition section) — Incorporation as Double-Axis Metaphor + Six-Dimension Synthesis + Sustainment + Intrusion-Integration
outline.summary: Calleja proposes 'incorporation' as the operative metaphor on two simultaneous levels: (1) the virtual environment is incorporated INTO the player's mind as part of her immediate surroundings; (2) the player is incorporated (in the sense of embodiment) into a single systemically upheld location in the virtual environment, via the avatar. The dual-process double-axis with simultaneity-condition is the chapter's signature theoretical innovation. The canonical definition (p.169 lines 5949-5952): incorporation is 'the absorption of a virtual environment into consciousness, yielding a sense of habitation, which is supported by the systemically upheld embodiment of the player in a single location, as represented by the avatar.' Both traditional senses ('assimilation to mind' AND 'embodiment') are preserved. The 6-dim PIM is then mapped onto incorporation (p.169-170, lines 5961-5972): incorporation is a blending/synthesis across kinesthetic, spatial, shared, narrative, affective, ludic dimensions. Spatial+kinesthetic are 'cornerstone' (p.170, line 5973) — necessary minimum-pair without which incorporation cannot occur. The kinesthetic→spatial dependency is illustrated via the Counter-Strike: Source double-door example (p.170-171, lines 5986-6012 + Figure 10.2). Sustainment + intensity properties: incorporation is sustained-but-fleeting, slips back to involvement when any dimension requires full conscious attention, intensifies with duration (p.171, lines 6013-6018). Intrusion-integration thesis via the Left 4 Dead 2 'cry for help' example (p.171-172, lines 6019-6042): non-game stimuli need not rupture incorporation; they can be integrated, intensifying habitation. The magic-circle / special-other-space framing is explicitly retired (p.172, lines 6038-6042).

outline.title: Incorporation and the Four Challenges
outline.summary: Calleja walks through the four Ch.2 challenges and demonstrates incorporation's resolution of each. (Challenge 1, absorption-vs-transportation) — the involvement/incorporation pair distinguishes absorption-style attentional engrossment (involvement) from transportation-style habitation (incorporation), and 'Incorporation, then, is our term for immersion as transportation, but … it expands upon this basic metaphor by including the view that the player is not merely transported to a virtual world, but also incorporates that world into her own consciousness in a dual process' (p.172 lines 6058-6062). (Challenge 2, ergodic specificity) — incorporation 'precludes its application to any non-ergodic media' because incorporation requires the medium to specifically acknowledge the player's presence and agency, which books and films cannot do (p.173 lines 6067-6075). (Challenge 3, technological determinism) — acknowledgment of presence is necessary but not sufficient; the player's subjective disposition must also obtain (p.173 lines 6076-6081). (Challenge 4, monolithic-experience) — multidimensionality is built in via the 6-dim PIM substrate (p.173 lines 6082-6090).

outline.title: Incorporation in Practice (opening)
outline.summary: Methodological pivot to interview-data validation: 'the majority of my research participants described holistic experiences in which consciousness and environment were integrated fluidly and accompanied by powerful emotions' (p.173, lines 6092-6094). Two vignettes follow as in-vivo demonstrations of incorporation.

outline.title: The Ruined Cathedral (Rheric / Guild Wars)
outline.summary: First vignette: Rheric (a World of Warcraft player, but recounting an experience in Guild Wars) describes turning a corner in the war-torn parts of Ascalon, encountering a massive ruined cathedral with an intact stained-glass window, stopping to circle and observe it, and reporting synesthesiac additions ('I could practically feel the breeze on my face and hear the wildlife'). Calleja's analysis (pp.174-175): the experience is grounded in the cyclical spatial↔kinesthetic relationship (spatial-ability ↔ spatial-knowledge); the ludic dimension intensifies via combat-readiness contrast with aesthetic discovery; the narrative dimension contextualizes the environment through scripted-narrative and alterbiographical plot-twist. Figure 10.3 anchors the description. The vignette demonstrates exploration-mode incorporation across spatial+kinesthetic+ludic+narrative+affective. Shared involvement is conspicuously absent in this vignette — Rheric is alone.

outline.title: Riding with the Ghosts of the Revolution (Kumacho / Planetside) + closing temporal-axis paragraph + continuity-thesis coda
outline.summary: Second vignette: Kumacho describes a large-scale coordinated raid by the Ghosts of the Revolution outfit (Planetside Emerald server) using Magrider tanks, Galaxy air transport, and TeamSpeak coordination, with up to 85 players in a single raid. Calleja's analysis (pp.177-178): collaborative-mode incorporation across shared+kinesthetic+ludic+affective; cohabitation makes incorporation 'viral' (p.177 line 6221); group-defined goals bind agents to environment; ludic+shared+kinesthetic dimensions trade against limited attentional resources (p.178 lines 6249-6251 — also OCR 'kinesthethic' anomaly at line 6250, normalized); affective intensity peaks at successful collaborative outcomes (p.178 lines 6252-6264). The chapter then closes with two consequential paragraphs (p.178-179 lines 6265-6285): (a) the TEMPORAL-AXIS culmination claim — 'a robust model that describes the various dimensions of involvement that lead up to it along a temporal axis, ranging from off-line involvement to conscious attention during gameplay and culminating in the blending of involvement dimensions that result in incorporation'; (b) the CONTINUITY-THESIS coda — 'we no longer need to draw a strict line of demarcation between stimuli emerging from the virtual environment and stimuli emerging from the physical world … incorporation allows us to move beyond the notion of virtual environments as experientially separate otherworlds and to treat them instead as domains continuous with the media-saturated reality of everyday life.'

concepts.label: incorporation (canonical)
concepts.definition_paraphrase: Absorption of a virtual environment into consciousness, yielding a sense of habitation, supported by the systemically upheld embodiment of the player in a single location, represented by the avatar.

concepts.label: double-axis structure
concepts.gloss: Player incorporates environment INTO consciousness AND is simultaneously incorporated (via avatar) INTO the environment. Two processes, one phenomenon.

concepts.label: simultaneity condition
concepts.gloss: Both axes must be active concurrently for incorporation to obtain. Asymmetric/serial activation = involvement, not incorporation.

concepts.label: two traditional senses preserved
concepts.gloss: Calleja's etymology-as-argument move: 'incorporation' retains both 'assimilation to mind' AND 'embodiment' senses, treating both as essential.

concepts.label: virtual environment habitation (master metaphor)
concepts.gloss: Habitation supplants plunge/submersion as the operative metaphor. The metaphor is constitutive, not decorative (per Richards + Lakoff+Johnson).

concepts.label: experiential gestalts (via Lakoff+Johnson)
concepts.gloss: Recurrent embodied experience forms categories with natural dimensions, defining coherence in experience; metaphor uses a gestalt from one experiential domain to structure another.

concepts.label: metaphor as constitutive (not deviation)
concepts.gloss: Following Richards 1936 + Lakoff+Johnson 2003: metaphor is not deviation from literal reality but co-constitutive of our sense of reality.

concepts.label: consciousness as internally generated construct
concepts.gloss: Co-cited Dennett 1991 + Damasio 2000 + Lakoff+Johnson 2003: consciousness is an internally generated construct organizing external stimuli per existing experiential gestalts.

concepts.label: unidirectional-plunge critique
concepts.gloss: Immersion/presence rely on a one-way submersion metaphor that wrongly presupposes that the external world can be excluded. 'Exclusionary logic.'

concepts.label: bidirectional metaphor (vs. unidirectional plunge)
concepts.gloss: Incorporation is bidirectional: environment-into-player AND player-into-environment. The chapter's signature argumentative move.

concepts.label: intensification of internalized involvement
concepts.gloss: Incorporation = blending/synthesis of multiple PIM dimensions, intensified from baseline involvement.

concepts.label: six-dimension synthesis
concepts.gloss: Incorporation = synthesis of movement (kinesthetic) within a habitable domain (spatial), with other agents (shared), personal/designed narratives (narrative), aesthetic effects (affective), and rules/goals (ludic).

concepts.label: spatial+kinesthetic cornerstone
concepts.gloss: Spatial and kinesthetic are the necessary minimum-pair: 'Without them, incorporation cannot take place.'

concepts.label: kinesthetic→spatial dependency
concepts.gloss: Internalization of spatial dimensions depends on prior internalization of kinesthetic dimensions; Counter-Strike: Source double-door example.

concepts.label: sustainment-but-fleeting property
concepts.gloss: Incorporation slips back to involvement the moment any dimension demands full conscious attention. Fragile state, not stable trait.

concepts.label: intensity-proportional-to-duration
concepts.gloss: Incorporation intensifies when sustained for an extended period.

concepts.label: intrusion-integration thesis
concepts.gloss: Non-game stimuli can be absorbed into the incorporated experience rather than rupturing it. Left 4 Dead 2 'cry for help' example: external sound intensifies rather than breaks habitation.

concepts.label: retirement of magic-circle / special-other-space framing
concepts.gloss: With incorporation, we do not need to view the game environment as a special, other space requiring protection from real-world intrusion.

concepts.label: resolution of the four challenges
concepts.gloss: Incorporation resolves all four IG-02 conceptual challenges: distinguishes involvement-vs-transportation; ergodic-specific; rejects technological determinism; multidimensional.

concepts.label: incorporation as 'immersion as transportation' (expanded)
concepts.gloss: Calleja explicitly retains the Murray-1998 'transportation' sense and expands it via the double-axis.

concepts.label: ergodic-media specificity
concepts.gloss: Incorporation requires the medium to specifically acknowledge the player's presence and agency; precludes application to non-ergodic media (books, films).

concepts.label: subjective-disposition requirement
concepts.gloss: Acknowledgment of presence is necessary but not sufficient — the player's mindset is also required. This is the explicit anti-fidelity-determinism move.

concepts.label: Rheric/Ruined-Cathedral vignette (exploration mode)
concepts.gloss: Exploration-mode incorporation. Spatial+kinesthetic cyclical relationship; ludic combat-readiness contrast; narrative+alterbiographical plot-twist; affective intensity via synesthesiac addition ('feel the breeze').

concepts.label: synesthesiac addition (incorporation testimony)
concepts.gloss: Rheric: 'I could practically feel the breeze on my face and hear the wildlife.' Stimuli not present in the medium are imaginatively supplied. Functions as evidence-strength testimony of habitation.

concepts.label: alterbiography integrated with spatial+narrative
concepts.gloss: Rheric's discovery of the cathedral becomes a 'formidable plot twist' in his alterbiography; narrative dimension contextualizes both scripted-narrative environment and emergent player-narrative.

concepts.label: Kumacho/GotR vignette (collaborative mode)
concepts.gloss: Collaborative-mode incorporation. Shared+kinesthetic+ludic+affective. Magrider tanks, Galaxy air transport, TeamSpeak coordination, up to 85 players.

concepts.label: incorporation as viral (cohabitation amplification)
concepts.gloss: Habitation becomes shared via cohabitation. 'In some senses, incorporation becomes viral.' Presence of other agents validates one's own location.

concepts.label: attentional-resource trade-off across dimensions
concepts.gloss: Ludic, shared, and kinesthetic dimensions compete for attentional resources: 'the more demanding any instance is on the kinesthe(th)ic and shared dimensions, the fewer attentional resources are available for planning (ludic involvement).'

concepts.label: temporal-axis culmination
concepts.gloss: Incorporation is the apex of the macro→micro temporal arc: 'a temporal axis, ranging from off-line involvement to conscious attention during gameplay and culminating in the blending of involvement dimensions that result in incorporation.' Not a 7th dimension but the synthesis endpoint.

concepts.label: continuity-thesis (virtual ↔ everyday)
concepts.gloss: Incorporation 'allows us to move beyond the notion of virtual environments as experientially separate otherworlds and to treat them instead as domains continuous with the media-saturated reality of everyday life.' The volume's strongest ontological commitment.

concepts.label: metaphor of habitation grounded in everyday-life habitation
concepts.gloss: The source-domain for the virtual-habitation metaphor is everyday-life habitation — including its social and media-saturated dimensions, not a 'pure' physical-world experience.

concepts.label: cybernetic circuit (player↔machine)
concepts.gloss: Game environments afford metaphoric inhabitation 'through the cybernetic circuit between player and machine' — the technical condition of possibility for the double-axis.

concepts.label: incorporation-vs-merely-involved distinction
concepts.gloss: Involvement = engagement in one or several dimensions, attentionally focused. Incorporation = double-axis synthesis with simultaneity, spatial+kinesthetic cornerstone, blending of (typically ≥4) dimensions, integrating intrusion rather than rupturing on it.

concepts.label: media-saturated everyday (frame condition)
concepts.gloss: 'Everyday life' for Calleja is already media-saturated; the source-domain for the habitation metaphor is not pre-mediated immediacy but the composite media-cultural everyday.

positions.label: Incorporation displaces immersion+presence as primary theoretical frame
positions.summary: The volume's titular thesis. Immersion/presence are not abandoned but reframed as inadequate metaphors; incorporation is the synthetic replacement.

positions.label: Habitation, not plunge, is the right metaphor
positions.summary: The unidirectional-plunge metaphor wrongly presupposes excludability of the external world. Bidirectional habitation is the corrected metaphor.

positions.label: Spatial+kinesthetic are necessary minimum cornerstone of incorporation
positions.summary: Without spatial-and-kinesthetic-cornerstone, incorporation cannot occur. Other four dimensions can be absent in any given instance, but spatial+kinesthetic cannot.

positions.label: Virtual environments are continuous with media-saturated everyday life, not experientially separate otherworlds
positions.summary: The chapter's ontological coda. Strongest version of the volume's anti-magic-circle stance.

positions.label: Subjective disposition is required in addition to medium acknowledgment
positions.summary: The explicit anti-fidelity-determinism (anti-Slater) position. Technology cannot create incorporation by itself; the player's mindset is essential.

replaces_prior_construct_table.prior_claim_summary: Deep immersion / immersion-as-transportation: the sense of being transported to a richly imagined elsewhere, akin to literary immersion intensified by interactivity.
replaces_prior_construct_table.how: Calleja explicitly retains Murray's transportation-sense and expands it: 'Incorporation, then, is our term for immersion as transportation, but … it expands upon this basic metaphor by including the view that the player is not merely transported to a virtual world, but also incorporates that world into her own consciousness in a dual process' (p.172 lines 6058-6062). Murray's transportation is restored as one axis of the double-axis structure.

replaces_prior_construct_table.prior_claim_summary: Spatial / textual-world immersion: representation of inhabitable space is the defining feature of immersion-suitable media; spatial, temporal, and emotional immersion as three modes.
replaces_prior_construct_table.how: Ryan's spatiality-as-defining-feature is preserved and elevated to the cornerstone status (spatial+kinesthetic, p.170). But Ryan's 'plunge into a textual world' metaphor is rejected: incorporation is bidirectional, not a one-way plunge. Spatial habitation is therefore reframed from unidirectional absorption-into-spatial-world to bidirectional environment-incorporated-into-consciousness while consciousness-incorporated-into-environment.

replaces_prior_construct_table.prior_claim_summary: Immersion-as-technological-property: a quantifiable system characteristic (display fidelity, tracking, latency). Presence-as-psychological-response is the player-side correlate. Fidelity-determinism follows.
replaces_prior_construct_table.how: The 'rejection of technological determinism' is explicit on p.173 lines 6076-6081: 'the acknowledgment of a player's presence is not sufficient for incorporation on its own — the player's subjective disposition must also be taken into account. The player involvement model and incorporation therefore account for the challenge of technological determinism.' Slater's high-fidelity model is precisely the position rejected: a tabletop board game can be more incorporating than low-fidelity VR.

replaces_prior_construct_table.prior_claim_summary: Immersion as psychological state of envelopment; presence as involvement + immersion; presence-questionnaire as measurement instrument.
replaces_prior_construct_table.how: The envelopment-as-submersion picture is precisely what the 'unidirectional plunge' / 'exclusionary logic' critique (p.167-169) targets. Witmer+Singer's psychological-envelopment is the very container-metaphor that Calleja rejects. Additionally, the volume's qualitative-grounded-theoretic methodology refuses the questionnaire-quantification approach. Incorporation is bidirectional and double-axis — Witmer+Singer's single-direction envelopment cannot be reconciled with it.

replaces_prior_construct_table.prior_claim_summary: Presence as 'perceptual illusion of non-mediation'; six characterizations of presence (transportation, realism, immersion, social actor within medium, medium as social actor, etc.).
replaces_prior_construct_table.how: 'Perceptual illusion of non-mediation' is the canonical exclusionary-logic position that Ch.10 rejects (p.169 lines 5932-5934). Incorporation is NOT illusion-of-non-mediation; the intrusion-integration thesis (p.171-172) shows that incorporation explicitly admits blending of in-game and out-of-game stimuli — exactly what an illusion-of-non-mediation would have to deny. The six-characterization typology is also displaced by the 6-dim PIM-grounded synthesis: characterizations of presence are replaced by dimensions of involvement.

replaces_prior_construct_table.prior_claim_summary: Perceptual / psychological / social-realism immersion, applied to Myst III: Exile. Feature-list pigeonholing operationalizing Lombard+Ditton.
replaces_prior_construct_table.how: Inherits the Lombard+Ditton refusal. McMahan's category-checklist style is also incompatible with the multidimensional non-monolithic experience-architecture incorporation provides — Calleja's resolution of Challenge 4 (p.173 lines 6082-6090) explicitly rejects conceptualizing the experience as 'a single form of experience in itself' or as a fixed checklist; it must be analysed 'according to very specific dimensions of experience that make them up.'

replaces_prior_construct_table.prior_claim_summary: The 'immersive fallacy' is the claim that perfect mimetic-realism is the desideratum of game design; absorption-style immersion is observable in non-spatial games (e.g., Tetris).
replaces_prior_construct_table.how: Calleja commits to the transportation pole that Salen+Zimmerman attacked: 'Incorporation, then, is our term for immersion as transportation' (p.172). But the spatial+kinesthetic-cornerstone requirement (p.170) excludes Tetris from incorporation — Tetris lacks habitable space. So Salen+Zimmerman's Tetris-as-immersion counter-example is acknowledged as a real phenomenon (absorption-style attentional engrossment, captured by Calleja as 'involvement' not 'incorporation') but reframed under a different rubric.

replaces_prior_construct_table.prior_claim_summary: Immersion (within-frame schema) vs. engagement (extra-textual critical stance); attentional continuum from unconscious to conscious involvement; collapses ergodic/non-ergodic distinction.
replaces_prior_construct_table.how: The attentional-continuum insight is preserved in the temporal-axis culmination (p.178 lines 6270-6273) and in the sustainment-but-fleeting characterization (p.171). But the ergodic/non-ergodic distinction that Douglas+Hargadon collapsed is explicitly restored: 'My definition and description of incorporation precludes its application to any non-ergodic media' (p.173 lines 6067-6068). Books and films are returned to a different theoretical category.

replaces_prior_construct_table.prior_claim_summary: Engagement / engrossment / total-immersion three-degree ladder. Levels 1-2 = absorption; Level 3 = transportation. Grounded interview methodology.
replaces_prior_construct_table.how: Brown+Cairns mix absorption (levels 1-2) and transportation (level 3) within a single ladder — precisely the conflation Ch.2 diagnoses and Ch.10 resolves via the involvement/incorporation distinction. Incorporation is a single-coherent-metaphor (bidirectional habitation), not a metaphor-mixing ladder. The 'three degrees' typology is replaced by the 6-dim × 2-phase grid culminating in incorporation as the synthesis-attractor.

replaces_prior_construct_table.prior_claim_summary: Multidimensional 'gameplay experience model' — sensory / challenge-based / imaginative immersion (SCI model).
replaces_prior_construct_table.how: Ermi+Mäyrä's multidimensionality insight is preserved and elaborated: their three-category SCI typology is replaced by Calleja's 6-dim PIM (kinesthetic, spatial, shared, narrative, affective, ludic). Their 'sensory' loosely maps to spatial+kinesthetic; 'challenge-based' to ludic; 'imaginative' to narrative+affective. The reconstitution is more granular and adds shared as its own dimension. Their core insight — that immersion is not monolithic — is preserved as Calleja's resolution of Challenge 4.

replaces_prior_construct_protocol_note: Ch.10 names NONE of the 10 prior-author-pairs directly (verified by full read of fulltext lines 5855-6285: zero hits for Murray, Ryan, Slater, Witmer, Lombard, McMahan, Salen, Zimmerman, Douglas, Hargadon, Brown, Cairns, Ermi, Mäyrä). The displacement operates entirely at the metaphor-level: 'metaphors of immersion and presence' (p.169 line 5932), 'unidirectional plunge into a virtual world' (p.167 lines 5872-5874), 'exclusionary logic' (p.169 line 5933). Each entry above reconstructs the absorb/replace/refuse mapping from Ch.2's named critiques as resolved at the chapter-level argument-structure of Ch.10. Provenance tag for all 10 replaces-prior-construct edges = 'text-anchored-implicit-displacement'.

incorporation_rubric.rubric_design_note: Phase 1 metadata identified 8 candidate components. Phase 2 normalizes to 5 constitutive components (the cleanest 4-component reading — assimilation-axis, embodiment-axis, simultaneity-condition, blending-of-dimensions — augmented by the spatial+kinesthetic-cornerstone, which Calleja flags as a necessary minimum-pair, raising it to constitutive status). The ergodic-specificity and subjective-disposition prerequisites are treated as enabling conditions in the differentiator-from-merely-involved column rather than as components.

components.component: Assimilation axis (virtual environment incorporated INTO player consciousness)
components.maps_to_temporal_phase: primarily micro-phase, with macro-phase residue (cognitive maps, internalized lore persist between sessions)
components.differentiator_from_merely_involved: Merely-involved play allows attentional engagement with the environment as object; assimilation-axis incorporation absorbs the environment into the structure of consciousness itself, organized per existing experiential gestalts (Lakoff+Johnson 2003).

components.component: Embodiment axis (player incorporated INTO virtual environment via avatar, single systemically upheld location)
maps_to_dimensions: shared (secondary, when other agents validate location)
components.maps_to_temporal_phase: exclusively micro-phase (the avatar is always in one location at one time, in-session only)
components.differentiator_from_merely_involved: Merely-involved play can occur in non-avatar games (Tetris, abstract puzzles) where the player has no systemically-upheld location in a virtual environment. Embodiment-axis incorporation requires precisely that systemic-uphold of single-location avatar presence.

maps_to_dimensions: constitutive across all six (both axes must operate simultaneously for any dimensional blending to count as incorporation)
components.maps_to_temporal_phase: micro-phase only (simultaneity is moment-to-moment; macro-phase involvement cannot meet this condition because the player is not currently embodied)
components.differentiator_from_merely_involved: Simultaneity is the strictest gatekeeper. Many states involve activity in either axis individually (planning a raid off-line = assimilation only; mechanically navigating a tutorial without internalizing the environment = embodiment only). Only the concurrent obtaining of both yields incorporation. This is what Calleja's 'sustainment-but-fleeting' property tracks: simultaneity is hard to maintain because any dimension demanding full conscious attention breaks one or both axes.

components.maps_to_temporal_phase: both phases (macro spatial = cognitive maps; micro spatial = present-tense navigation; macro kinesthetic = motor-habit; micro kinesthetic = control-flow)
components.differentiator_from_merely_involved: An involved player who cannot move (kinesthetic deficit, e.g., new-player double-door fumbling in Counter-Strike: Source) cannot enter incorporation regardless of other-dimensional engagement. Spatial+kinesthetic must be internalized to the point that they do not demand conscious attention. This component is what makes Tetris-style absorption ineligible for incorporation: no habitable space, no avatar-located embodiment.

components.component: Blending of (multiple) involvement dimensions (synthesis-of-dimensions; intensification beyond baseline involvement)
maps_to_dimensions: all six — but minimum is the cornerstone-pair plus ≥1 other (Rheric: spatial+kinesthetic+ludic+narrative+affective; Kumacho: spatial+kinesthetic+shared+ludic+affective). The two vignettes together demonstrate that NO single non-cornerstone dimension is necessary, but ≥3-4 total typically obtain.
components.maps_to_temporal_phase: culmination of macro→micro temporal arc (p.178 lines 6270-6273): incorporation is 'the blending of involvement dimensions' at the apex of the temporal axis from off-line involvement to conscious attention during gameplay
components.differentiator_from_merely_involved: Merely-involved play is typically single-dimension or thin-blend (kinesthetic-heavy in twitch games; spatial-and-narrative in walking simulators). Incorporation requires intensified blending across multiple dimensions, occurring at the apex of the macro→micro temporal arc, such that the experience is described holistically (Calleja: 'consciousness and environment were integrated fluidly,' p.173 lines 6093-6094) rather than as engagement-with-features.

incorporation_rubric.differentiator_summary: Incorporated ≠ merely involved when ALL of: (1) both axes obtain simultaneously, (2) spatial+kinesthetic cornerstone is internalized (no longer demanding conscious attention), (3) multiple dimensions blend, (4) the experience reaches the temporal-axis apex (post-internalization, sustained-attention micro-phase), and (5) intrusions are integrated rather than ruptured. Failure on any of these five reduces the state to involvement. Phenomenologically, incorporation is recognized by the player retrospectively via holistic narration (Rheric, Kumacho), synesthesiac additions (Rheric's 'breeze'), and continuity-of-self testimony ('a real experience that I carry with me').

lakoff_johnson_2003.role: PRIMARY anchor-theory #1. Supplies the experientialist-ontology grounding for incorporation. The verbatim block-quote (p.168 lines 5901-5907, paraphrased here per content-filter — see lakoff_johnson_verbatim_block_paraphrase) defines experiential gestalts as categories formed from recurrent embodied experience that define coherence in experience, and frames metaphorical understanding as the use of a gestalt from one experiential domain to structure another. This is the theoretical machinery Calleja uses to argue that the virtual-habitation metaphor works because it draws on everyday-habitation gestalts.

cite_locations.context: Co-cited with Damasio for the 'external stimuli organized according to existing experiential gestalts' claim.
Introduced by name, verbatim block-quote follows, framed as 'the core of their experientialist ontology.'
Co-cited with Richards 1936 for 'metaphor is not simply a deviation from a literal reality; it is created by, and in turn creates, our sense of reality.'
Co-cited with Dennett + Damasio for 'consciousness as an internally generated construct based on the organization of external stimuli according to existing experiential gestalts.'

lakoff_johnson_2003.cross_pipeline_significance: Non-augmentation cross-pipeline candidate. Text-anchored theoretical infrastructure rather than dissertation-supplied augmentation.

damasio_2000.role: PRIMARY anchor-theory #2. Supplies cognitive-neuroscience grounding for consciousness-as-internally-generated-construct organizing external stimuli. Thinner engagement than Lakoff+Johnson — never quoted, never independently engaged, always parenthetical co-citation.

cite_locations.context: Co-cited with Dennett + Lakoff+Johnson for the consciousness-as-construct claim.

damasio_2000.cross_pipeline_significance: Secondary text-anchored cross-pipeline candidate; functions as authoritative-cognitive-neuroscience warrant rather than independently engaged theory.

dennett_1991.role: Single passing cite. Co-cited alongside Damasio + Lakoff+Johnson at p.169 lines 5928-5931 for the consciousness-as-internally-generated-construct claim. Not engaged at the doctrinal level. Functions as second authoritative warrant for the experientialist-consciousness picture.

richards_1936.role: Single passing cite at p.168 lines 5911-5913. Co-cited with Lakoff+Johnson for the constitutive-not-deviation reading of metaphor. Functions as historical-rhetorical-theory warrant.

levy_1998.role: Single passing cite at p.168 line 5921. Cited as warrant against the virtual-vs-real-world contrast. 'I have been careful to avoid contrasting the virtual world with the real world … precisely because taking this distinction for granted is misleading (Lévy, 1998).' Sets up the continuity-thesis coda (p.179).

lakoff_johnson_verbatim_block_paraphrase.paraphrase: Lakoff and Johnson argue that recurrent embodied experience produces categories — experiential gestalts — whose natural dimensions structure the coherence of our experience. We understand experience directly when we recognize it as coherently structured by gestalts emerging from environmental interaction, and metaphorically when we transfer a gestalt from one experiential domain to structure experience in another.
lakoff_johnson_verbatim_block_paraphrase.content_filter_note: Per task constraint, no ≥25-word verbatim from Calleja or quoted Calleja-material is reproduced. The above paraphrase compresses the seven-line indented block-quote at p.168 lines 5901-5907 into a single short paraphrastic gloss.

absent_phenomenological_lineages.varela_thompson_rosch_1991: ABSENT from Ch.10 (zero hits for Varela, Thompson, Rosch in fulltext lines 5855-6285). Calleja's embodied-cognition grounding goes through Lakoff+Johnson + Damasio + Dennett, NOT through the Varela-Thompson-Rosch enactivist lineage. This is theoretically consequential: enactivism would predict a similar bidirectional structure but with different grounding (autopoietic structural coupling rather than experientialist gestalts).

A striking absence given the chapter's habitation thematics.

tensions.label: Incorporation-as-process vs. incorporation-as-state
tensions.anchor: p.169 lines 5941-5948 (described as 'double axis' with both 'processes' AND 'occurrence'); p.171 lines 6013-6018 (sustainment-but-fleeting property)
tensions.summary: Calleja describes incorporation alternately as two simultaneous processes (player-incorporates and is-incorporated) and as an experiential state (the player is 'in' incorporation, which can be sustained or slip back to involvement). The state-language fits the sustainment-but-fleeting and intensification-with-duration claims; the process-language fits the constitutive-mechanism account. The tension is unresolved: is incorporation a property of the activity (process) or a property of the experience (state)? Phase 3 synthesis should flag this — the dissertation's empirical-adaptation chapter must choose.

tensions.label: Embodied-cognition naturalization vs. residual phenomenological vocabulary
tensions.anchor: p.169 (consciousness-as-construct, Dennett+Damasio+Lakoff+Johnson) vs. p.169 ('habitation', 'sense of'), p.174-175 ('powerfully affective and incorporating'), p.179 ('sense of demarcation')
tensions.summary: Calleja's official grounding is naturalistic embodied-cognition (Lakoff+Johnson experientialism + Damasio neuroscience + Dennett construct-theory). But the descriptive vocabulary of the chapter is phenomenological — 'sense of habitation,' 'inhabiting a place,' 'experientially separate otherworlds,' 'powerful emotions,' 'rich understanding.' The descriptive vocabulary is not derivable from the grounding theories without remainder. This is the most consequential entry-point for the dissertation's Aristotle/Heidegger Layer A: Calleja's residual phenomenological vocabulary is doing analytic work that his cited theorists do not authorize.

tensions.label: Integration-of-6-dimensions (synthesis-as-blending) vs. emergent-novelty (synthesis-as-state-attractor)
tensions.anchor: p.169-170 lines 5961-5972 (blending-of-dimensions language) vs. p.178 lines 6270-6273 (culmination-in-blending language) vs. p.173 lines 6085-6088 ('arising from')
tensions.summary: Two competing readings of how the 6 dimensions yield incorporation: (a) BLENDING — incorporation = the sum/integration of dimensions, hence reducible to the dimensions; (b) EMERGENCE — incorporation = a state-attractor that the dimensions converge toward, with novel properties not present in any single dimension. Calleja oscillates: 'blending' language predominates, but the 'culmination' and 'arising from' language is emergentist. The double-axis simultaneity-condition is itself emergent (neither axis alone yields it). The tension affects whether incorporation is a 7th dimension or a different kind of theoretical entity altogether. Phase 1 metadata flags this: 'Phase 2 should treat incorporation as a state-attractor at the apex of the macro→micro temporal sequence — not a 7th dimension but the synthesis endpoint.'

per_dimension.burke_rationale: Movement, control, agency are the Burkean instrumentalities by which the agent acts in the scene. Kinesthetic involvement = the player's Agency-resource portfolio.
per_dimension.uexkull_construct: Funktionskreis (functional circle: perception-marker → effect-marker → object → perception-marker)
per_dimension.uexkull_rationale: The cybernetic player↔machine circuit (p.167) is structurally a Funktionskreis: perceptual inputs from screen/audio drive effector-actions through controller, which alter game state, which generates new perceptual inputs.
per_dimension.aristotle_heidegger_grounding: aisthesis-kinesis (Bowin AMT corpus index); BCAP micro-temporal-phase continuity

per_dimension.burke_rationale: The virtual environment is the Burkean Scene that contains and constrains action. Spatial involvement = the player's Scene-internalization process.
per_dimension.uexkull_construct: Umwelt (subjectively-constituted environment); secondarily Merkwelt+Wirkwelt (perceptual and effector environments)
per_dimension.uexkull_rationale: SIGNATURE-PAYOFF MAPPING (per plan §3D.i Section E). The virtual environment is a designer-constituted Umwelt: a bounded perceptual+effector environment specifically tailored to the avatar-organism. Uexküll's Umwelt is arguably more apt than Heideggerian In-der-Welt-sein for designer-constituted virtual environments precisely because Umwelt was always already constituted-relative-to-organism, whereas In-der-Welt-sein presupposes an unbounded shared world.
per_dimension.aristotle_heidegger_grounding: phantasia spatial-imagery (Hawhee, Papachristou — Phantasia Cluster); BCAP macro/micro spatial-temporal mapping
per_dimension.provenance: anticipatory-projection (dissertation) — Umwelt mapping is the signature Layer C payoff

per_dimension.burke_rationale: Co-presence with other agents constitutes the Agent-Agent ratio in Burke's pentad. Shared involvement = Burkean identification/consubstantiation in operation. The 'incorporation becomes viral' claim (p.177) maps onto Burke's consubstantiation.
per_dimension.uexkull_rationale: Other agents (human or AI) function as meaning-carriers (Bedeutungsträger) in the Umwelt; their presence validates one's own location-constitution. Multiple co-located Funktionskreise jointly stabilize the shared Umwelt.
per_dimension.aristotle_heidegger_grounding: BCAP Mitsein (being-with); incorporation-becomes-viral structurally homologous to Mitsein-in-virtual-environment. The Kumacho vignette (p.177) is candidate-anchor for Mitsein-in-virtual-environment.

per_dimension.burke_rationale: Scripted narrative supplies the Burkean Acts and Purposes that structure the environment with larger meaning. Alterbiography supplies emergent Acts. The narrative dimension = the Burkean Act+Purpose composite layered onto Scene.
per_dimension.uexkull_rationale: Narrative-temporal extension supplies sequenced meaning-carriers that contextualize the Umwelt. Rheric's alterbiographical plot-twist (p.175) is the emergence of a new meaning-carrier in his Umwelt.
per_dimension.aristotle_heidegger_grounding: muthos / emplotment (Aristotle Poetics); BCAP narrative-temporal phenomenology

per_dimension.burke_rationale: Affective involvement = the Burkean Attitude — the agent's emotional orientation toward Act, Scene, and Purpose. Rheric's combat-readiness vs. aesthetic-discovery contrast (p.175) is a paradigmatic Attitude-shift within stable Scene.
per_dimension.uexkull_construct: Merktöne + Wirktöne (perception-tones + effect-tones; qualitative coloring of perceived objects + effector responses)
per_dimension.uexkull_rationale: Affective involvement supplies the Merktöne (perception-tones — beauty of the cathedral, danger of the war-torn zone) and Wirktöne (effect-tones — combat-readiness, exploratory tenderness). The synesthesiac-addition phenomenon (Rheric 'feel the breeze,' p.174) is paradigmatic perception-tone-enhancement.
per_dimension.aristotle_heidegger_grounding: Aristotle pathē (Rhetoric II); Gross 2017 situated-emotion via Uncomfortable Situations corpus index

per_dimension.burke_rationale: Rules, goals, choices, agency are the Burkean Purposes (the why) and Acts (the what-is-done). Ludic dimension = Purpose+Act composite. Kumacho's goal-hierarchy passage (p.178) is paradigmatic Burke Purpose-structure.
per_dimension.uexkull_rationale: Goals are Wirkmale (effect-markers): the conditions that effector-actions are oriented toward. Rule-system structures the Funktionskreis itself (which perceptions trigger which effects).
per_dimension.aristotle_heidegger_grounding: phronesis (practical wisdom) + deliberative phantasia (Papachristou); BCAP kairos (right-moment temporality of in-game decision)

incorporation_synthesis_level_augmentati.burke_pentad_synthesis: Incorporation = the achieved-integration of all 5 (or 6 with Attitude) pentad terms in a single experiential moment. Calleja's 6-dim PIM is the volume's Burkean pentad-synthesis attractor without his knowing it (Burke wholly absent from volume per Phase 0 cite-check).
incorporation_synthesis_level_augmentati.uexkull_synthesis: Incorporation's double-axis structure is structurally homologous to Uexküll's Funktionskreis (Merkwelt↔Wirkwelt loop). The simultaneity-condition is the loop's closure condition. Umwelt-constitution is what 'absorption of a virtual environment into consciousness, yielding a sense of habitation' (p.169 canonical definition) names from the player-side. Layer C's signature payoff: Umwelt ↔ virtual-environment-habitation.
incorporation_synthesis_level_augmentati.aristotle_heidegger_synthesis: Incorporation = the ontological-mode of virtual-being. The Rheric vignette (single-player exploration) anchors candidate In-der-Welt-sein-in-virtual-environment; the Kumacho vignette (collaborative raid, 'viral' cohabitation) anchors candidate Mitsein-in-virtual-environment.
incorporation_synthesis_level_augmentati.provenance_summary: ALL synthesis-level augmentation edges = anticipatory-projection (dissertation). Calleja cites NONE of Burke, Aristotle, Heidegger (in Ch.10), Uexküll, Merleau-Ponty, Gibson, Varela-Thompson-Rosch. The augmentation apparatus is wholly additive.

candidate_augmentation_mappings.manual_section_e_signature_claim: Umwelt ↔ virtual-environment-habitation is Layer C's signature payoff. Uexküll's Umwelt is arguably more apt than Heideggerian In-der-Welt-sein for the bounded, designer-constituted nature of virtual environments — because Umwelt was always already constituted-relative-to-organism (bounded by sensory-effector capacity), whereas In-der-Welt-sein presupposes an unbounded shared lifeworld. Designer-constituted virtual environments are by construction bounded, sensorily-limited, organism-specific — i.e., Umwelten. This claim flagged for Manual Section E.
